definitions.explanation: A category or style of something.
A container used to give shape to something.
A set form or sequence of movements in martial arts.

notes:
{型|かた} has multiple related meanings: type/model, mold/form, and pattern (martial arts).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{血液型|けつえきがた}→血液型：03053_ketsuekigata⟧: blood type
- ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧: new model
- ⟦{旧型|きゅうがた}→旧型：18276_kyuugata⟧: old model
- ⟦{型紙|かたがみ}→型紙：07349_katagami⟧: pattern (sewing)
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧: large size/type
- ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧: small size/type

AS SUFFIX:
〜{型|がた} indicates "type" or "model": A{型|がた} (Type A).

MARTIAL ARTS:
{型|かた} (kata) is a set sequence of movements for training in karate, judo, etc.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{型|かた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦はまる→嵌まる：04256_hamaru⟧: to be conventional, to follow a set pattern.
